title: The Hunt Order Descends
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji made his decision, Ye Qing suddenly lowered her voice and revealed a long-buried secret—that the current Master of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion seemed to have some unknown blood connection with the Chen family...

text.content: The sky darkened to ink. That eye, beyond mortal comprehension, did not dissipate but slowly turned, as if searching for something. A majestic voice descended from the nine heavens, shaking the hearts of cultivators for a thousand miles around.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, one who steals Heavenly Secrets shall face Heavenly Execution. A worldwide hunt order—those who bring back his head alive shall be rewarded with one hundred thousand Heavenly Fate Stones, three Xuan-rank cultivation techniques, and ten years of access to the Spirit Spring Sacred Land.

text.content: As the words fell, transmission jade slips from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion flew like snowflakes to the major sects. Meanwhile, the eyes of countless cultivators ignited with greedy flames—the bounty was high enough to bankrupt any mid-sized sect.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood at a cliff edge on the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, letting the fierce wind whip his robes. His expression remained unchanged as he gazed at the eye suspended in the sky, though his knuckles beneath his sleeves had turned white.

text.content: One hundred thousand Heavenly Fate Stones. Xuan-rank techniques. Spirit Spring Sacred Land. Any one of these conditions alone would be enough to tempt an old monster at the Yuan Ying stage, let alone ordinary cultivators at the Jin Dan or Foundation Building stages. From this moment, he would become prey for the entire world.

dialogue.content: "They are coming." From the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rang out, "The Heavenly Dao's Eye personally issued the hunt order—this is to drive you into a desperate corner. However..." His tone carried a hint of amusement, "This hunt order itself is a weakness."

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly: "What do you mean, Master?" Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted leisurely over: "The prerequisite for the hunt order is—that you are already dead. If you appear in your true identity, all the lies about your faked death will crumble on their own."

dialogue.content: Demonic energy gathered quietly at Chen Ji's side as Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows. Her face was unusually devoid of smiles, replaced by a grave expression: "Chen Ji, someone from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion has arrived."

She handed over a token as black as ink, on which an ancient "机" character was carved: "The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Master has asked me to convey one message to you—join us, or become an enemy of the entire world."

text.content: Chen Ji took the token, his fingertips tracing over the "机" character. It felt ice-cold, yet a familiar Blood Pulse faintly emanated from it—this feeling was subtle, like some long-buried memory being gently stirred.

dialogue.content: He raised his head, his gaze calm as he looked at Ye Qing: "Why does the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion want to protect me? I don't recall having any dealings with you." A playful arc curved at the corner of his mouth, "Could it be... the Pavilion Master also has the surname Chen?"

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes slightly contracted, clearly not expecting him to guess so accurately. She gave no direct answer, only pressing a jade slip into his hand: "The Pavilion Master says if you want answers, come to the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion yourself. Valid for thirty days."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's hunt order had been issued, and the entire world searched for Chen Ji's whereabouts. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion token Ye Qing brought was both an olive branch and a final ultimatum. At this moment, he had to make a decision that would influence the entire situation.

choices.description: Proactively appear in his true identity, breaking the faked death claim, rendering the Heavenly Dao's Eye's hunt order meaningless. This would also allow him to test the reactions of all parties.
choices.visible_cost: Losing the advantage of disguise, may face direct encirclement and attack
choices.visible_reward: Truth revealed, collapsing the legal foundation of the hunt order
choices.risk_hint: If no one responds, will fall into isolation with no help

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the token into his sleeve and said calmly: "Since they want to see my face, I'll let them see enough." Before the words even finished, he had already stepped forward, his form like lightning as he raced toward the Tianqing Sect Main Peak.

Ye Qing's brow creased tightly: "Have you gone mad?" Chen Ji glanced back, a gleam of light flashing in his eyes: "Sometimes the most dangerous path is the safest. When everyone thinks I'm fleeing, I'll boldly stand forward instead."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly: "Interesting. I'll accompany you on this journey and see which heroes in this world dare to reach for your head."

choices.description: Continue to lurk using the faked death identity, arranging things secretly. Playing a game of hiding in plain sight right under the nose of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information asymmetry advantage, secretly gather strength
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, credibility will be completely ruined

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the token away, his expression returning to dullness: 'I am now thetrash Chen Ji, the most卑微的 servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect. The world kill order seeks Chen Ji, not me.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes flickered with disappointment: 'Will you be a turtle hiding in its shell?' Chen Ji gently shook his head: 'No, it is about turning the hunter into prey.' His tone was calm, yet carried a chilling coldness that made one's heart race.

choices.text: Borrowing power from the Tianji Pavilion
choices.description: Accept the Tianji Pavilion's invitation, seek refuge there. Yet this means stepping into an unknown sphere of influence.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into a new chess game, be controlled by others
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful backing, escape the current predicament
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Pavilion's goodwill may not come without a price

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at the token in his hand, suddenly smiling: 'Since the master of Tianji Pavilion is so sincere, I have no reason to refuse.' Ye Qing nodded slightly: 'A wise choice.'

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the token to his brow center, an arcane formation enveloping it. He felt a strange power surge into his body—the Tianji Pavilion's guiding method, capable of concealing aura for a short time to evade pursuit.

dialogue.content: 'Ye Qing, there is something I do not understand,' Chen Ji suddenly said. 'What is the surname of the Tianji Pavilion's master?' Ye Qing's body stiffened almost imperceptibly, then returned to normal: 'You will know when you arrive there.'

text.content: Just then, commotion arose within the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji's divine sense caught several familiar auras rapidly approaching—Inner Sect disciples, with Han Lie and Senior Brother Zhang's spiritual energy fluctuations mixed in.

dialogue.content: 'It seems someone can no longer sit still.' Chen Ji said coldly. Han Lie, that Xuanwu Sect genius whom he had crushed countless times while appearing as trash, was now leading a group of people in a murderous advance.

text.content: 'Chen Ji!' Han Lie's voice exploded like thunder. 'The world kill order has been issued—where do you think you can escape to? Today, I shall execute heavenly justice and take this traitor's head!' Behind him, over a dozen Jindan-stage cultivators all drew their weapons.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stood before Chen Ji, demonic path mist quietly spreading: 'With the likes of you trash, you dare touch him?' Her voice was ice-cold and biting, 'The honored guest of Tianji Pavilion—you dare touch?'

text.content: Han Lie's expression slightly changed, but then he grinned wickedly: 'Tianji Pavilion? Hmph, so what? The kill order personally issued by the Eye of Heavenly Dao—who dares defy?' He furiously waved his hand. 'Kill! Chen Ji's head belongs to the Xuanwu Sect!'

choice.prompt: Han Lie led over a dozen Jindan cultivators in a siege. Though Ye Qing's demonic path mist was formidable, facing such numbers, it would not last. Chen Ji had to respond.

choices.description: Use absolute strength to crush Han Lie head-on, letting all witness the true power of the 'trash.' Kill the chicken to warn the monkeys.
choices.visible_cost: Expose true combat power, lose the advantage of playing dumb
choices.visible_reward: Deter the insignificant, making enemies afraid to act rashly
choices.process_label: break cleverness with force, end quickly

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sighed lightly, slowly straightening his body. In an instant, his surrounding aura drastically changed—that weak and卑微的气息 like a tide receded, replaced by a terrifying sharpness.

text.content: "Han Lie." Chen Ji's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. "I remember you, losing to me every single time, every time saying you'd definitely win next time." A hint of mocking smile curled at the corner of his lips. "This time will be the same."

Before the words even finished, Chen Ji had already turned into a phantom. In the next instant, Han Lie didn't even have time to react before a pale hand had already pressed against his chest. "Bang!" A muffled sound rang out, and the proud number one genius of Xuanwu Sect was sent flying like a kite with cut strings, crashing through three century-old ancient pines before barely coming to a stop.

choices.description: Avoid direct confrontation with Han Lie, use terrain and layout to create chaos, take the opportunity to escape. Preserve strength, let the enemy be in the open while you stay hidden.
choices.risk_hint: May Be Seen as a Coward

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly clutched his chest, coughing violently, a mouthful of blood spewing out. He stumbled back several steps, his voice weak yet clearly reaching Ye Qing's ears: "Retreat!"

text.content: Ye Qing understood immediately. The Demonic Path Mist surged massively, shrouding a hundred zhang in all directions within a curtain of darkness. Han Lie's attack pierced through the mist, but only struck several phantoms. By the time the mist dispersed, Chen Ji had long vanished without a trace.

dialogue.content: "Despicable!" Han Lie roared. "He's severely injured—he can't have gone far! Search for him!" A flash of humiliation flickered in his eyes—that waste hadn't even shown any interest in fighting him?

text.content: Meanwhile, in a certain pavilion within Tianqing Sect's Inner Sect, Su Qingyao stood quietly by the window, gazing at the commotion in the direction of the Rear Mountain. Her eyes flickered with complex light, carrying both worry and a hint of barely perceptible disappointment.

dialogue.content: "Ji, what exactly are you hiding?" she murmured softly, the Jade Slip in her hand already cracked from her grip. Three times—she had gotten infinitely close to the truth three times, and three times he had sidestepped with all kinds of excuses.

text.content: Su Qingyao took a deep breath and turned to walk toward Tianqing Sect's Council Hall. The kill order had been issued. No matter what Chen Ji had done, she had to make a choice—stand with the sect, or... protect that man she could never quite see through.

dialogue.content: In a secluded mountain valley, Chen Ji and Ye Qing's figures materialized from the Void. The Demonic Path Mist isolated all forms of detection, but Ye Qing's expression was not relaxed: "Chen Ji, how have you considered the invitation from the Hall of Heavenly Secrets?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he gazed toward the distant horizon. That Eye of Heavenly Way still hovered there, watching the mortal world coldly. He suddenly spoke: "Ye Qing... does the Hall Master of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets have some connection to me?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's body visibly stiffened. She fell silent for a long moment before slowly speaking: "You ask too many questions." Her tone carried a rare hint of hesitation. "However... I can tell you one thing."

text.content: Ye Qing turned around, her gaze fixed directly on Chen Ji's eyes: "The Hall Master of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets does have a blood connection to your Chen family. But what exactly that relationship is, even I don't know." Her voice was very low. "This matter, the entire Hall of Heavenly Secrets treats it as a taboo."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. He thought of his sister Chen Nian, missing for many years. He thought of the incomplete Tianji Record. He thought of Mo Xiansheng's meaningful words—all the mysteries seemed to point in the same direction.

text.content: "Alright." Chen Ji finally made his decision. "I'll go to the Hall of Heavenly Secrets." A flash of determination flickered in his eyes. "Since someone is setting up a game in the shadows, I'll go see for myself how large this chess game truly is."

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's lips finally curved into a smile: "A wise choice." She drew a transmission talisman from her sleeve. "The location of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets cannot be exposed. This is a temporary transmission array. Crush it, and three breaths later you will arrive at the perimeter of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: Chen Ji took the talisman, but did not crush it immediately. He turned to gaze in the direction of Tianqing Sect, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. There were the connections he had built over many years, the Su Qingyao who had always been investigating him in secret, and the old Sect Master Ling Yuan who had long coveted the Tianji Record inheritance.

dialogue.content: "Wait for me to return." Chen Ji said softly, his tone carrying both a promise and a warning. He pressed the talisman against his Brow Center, Spiritual Energy flowing into it. In the next instant, a flash of white light swallowed his entire body, and his figure vanished from the spot.

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at the direction where Chen Ji had disappeared, sighing softly: "Chen Ji, Chen Ji, do you know that the place you're stepping into is more dangerous than the Eye of Heavenly Way's kill order?" Her voice dissipated in the wind, carrying an indescribable worry.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself standing atop a sea of clouds. Beneath his feet churned waves of clouds, in the distance stretched continuous mountains, and right before him, a majestic palace floated above the clouds, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura.

dialogue.content: In the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out, carrying a rare gravity: "Chen Ji, on the road ahead, I cannot help you. The Hall Master of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets... is that existence I will only reveal at the very end."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill run through his heart. For something to be treated with such solemnity by Mo Xiansheng, its significance could be imagined. He took a deep breath, straightened his robes, and strode toward the floating palace. He knew that from the moment he stepped into that palace, his life would enter a completely new chapter.

Just as Chen Ji was about to step through the palace gates, an ancient yet commanding voice rang out from the depths of the palace: 'You have finally arrived, child of the Chen family.' That voice seemed to have traversed endless years, carrying a chilling sense of familiarity.

Chen Ji froze mid-stride. That voice... why did it sound so familiar? Instinctively, he reached toward his chest, where a broken Jade Pendant lay pressed against his skin—a Chen family heirloom, and his sole connection to his sister Chen Nian.
